_comment: LetzAI model catalogue: the one source for models, prices and provider routes. The API serves it: GET /catalog is the public view (no provider internals), GET /internal/catalog the whole file for the inference workers. Edit models here and nowhere else.

_pricingSchema.image: Use mode key (1k, 2k, hd, 4k, uhd) or _flat for fixed price
_pricingSchema.video: Use _flat OR (_perSecond × duration). Apply multipliers: _audioMultiplier (if audio enabled), _hqMultiplier (if HQ enabled). Multiplier defaults to 1 if not specified. Special: _withAudio overrides flat+audio cost.
_pricingSchema.upscaling: Image: size key (e.g. '1k','2k','4k') or scale-factor key (e.g. '2x','4x','8x') or _flat. Video (mediaType=video): (_perSecond1080p|_perSecond4k) × duration seconds; size 8→1080p, 12→4K.
_pricingSchema.audio: Speech: _per1kChars x characters of script (at least 1). Music and sound effects: _perSecond x seconds delivered, never more than the seconds asked for. Seed Audio speech has no length up front; it is billed _perSecond on the delivered sound. A run on a customer key costs 1 credit.
_pricingSchema.text: Agent text models, in USD per million tokens (list price, before the agent markup): _inputPerMTok, _cacheWrite5mPerMTok, _cacheReadPerMTok, _outputPerMTok. Optional _longContextAboveTokens with _longContextInputMul and _longContextOutputMul: above that many billed prompt tokens the whole request reprices. Every text model, retired ones included, carries a price so usage on it still bills. A retired model names its successor in `replacedBy`.
